automated.scope: Production code, real Three/OrbitControls and event/bitmap fixtures; not native GPU-memory measurement.

nativeBrowser.scope: Keyboard, mouse click/drag/wheel, native touch tap, mobile geometry, focused-button withdrawal, three GLB imports/replacements and clear. No context-recovery rerun or memory measurement.

limits: GPU memory reduction and real-device performance are not measured.
v17 controlled context recovery remains historical evidence, not counted as v18 tests.
Desktop feeding capture is the initial approach phase; mobile capture shows the visible hand.
